items.headline: Man United beat Ipswich Town 5-2 after opening loss to Hull City
items.summary: After losing 2-0 to Hull on opening day, Manchester United defeated Ipswich Town 5-2 in a strong showing, bouncing back impressively.

items.headline: Manchester United closes summer window with seven signings, 24 departures
items.summary: The 2026 summer transfer deadline passed. United added seven players and parted ways with 24 others via loans, transfers and expiring contracts.

items.headline: Man United linked with Newcastle left-back Lewis Hall, deal did not materialise
items.summary: Man United pursued Newcastle's Lewis Hall as a potential left-back signing but failed to complete the transfer despite late discussions.

items.headline: Chido Obi set for Eredivisie loan move day after transfer window closed
items.summary: Manchester United forward Chido Obi agreed a loan deal to an Eredivisie club, completed post-deadline following agreement.
